description: A singleton class for managing notifications, including price and news alerts, utilizing shared preferences for state persistence and Firebase messaging for topic subscriptions.

classes.name: NotificationManager
classes.description: Manages notifications related to price alerts and news alerts, handles subscription to relevant Firebase topics based on user preferences.

methods.name: updatePriceAlerts
methods.description: Updates the state of price alerts and modifies the user's subscription status for price alerts.

methods.name: updateNewsAlerts
methods.description: Updates the state of news alerts and modifies the user's subscription status for news alerts.

methods.name: updateSubscription
methods.description: Manages the subscription to Firebase messaging topics based on the provided topic name and subscription status.

methods.name: isPriceAlertsEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether price alerts are enabled based on shared preferences.

methods.name: isNewsAlertsEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether news alerts are enabled based on shared preferences.
